scientific_integrity: Analytical proof of universal quantifiers; finite Fourier and random Gram computations are corroborative only; a previously established order-one instance is expressly credited, not reprioritized.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three equally weighted point samples on one-dimensional circle; strictly decreasing even circular kernels satisfying a sign condition; real fractional Sobolev smoothness s>1/2; no claim for four sites, weights, noise or arbitrary kernels.
title: Universal three-site circular minimax kernels and fractional Sobolev trace designs
